notes.title: Christmas Update and Sale
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, a new patch for Gun Wings has now been released. Here is the update log:

1. You can now unlock Practise Mode just by finishing normal difficulty.

2. Fixed some incorrect translations.

3. Updated some background resources.

During Steam's Christmas event all our catalog will be on sale up to 60% off! For details please visit the link here:

http://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Angels%20Blue%20Digital%20Entertainment

Wish you have a merry Christmas!

notes.title: Gun Wings Update 28th Jan, 2016
notes.notes:
A new patch for Gun Wings has been released. We have fixed several bugs/mistakes reported by the community. If you have any more questions, feel free to report it in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/348240/discussions/0/492379439690885596/]this thread[/url].

1. Added the "L" button. You can now either use Shift or the L button to move slowly.

2. Added a notice: "Press F11 to switch to fullscreen."

3. Slightly modified the controller's deadzone.

4. Added three new character designs in the statistics screen for each character.

5. Added a new ending to the game's story.

6. Fixed the issue of people still hearing the button tones when the game is minimized.

7. Fixed translation errors in the Russian and Japanese localizations.

8. Fixed the "Charge-Attack Genius" achievement not working properly in some situations.

9. Fixed a bug where the game would not run on certain versions of Windows.

10. Some other minor fixes.

Thanks for your support.
